Translation: 这个房间臭气熏天，一定是浴室，而且漆黑一片。除非我们找到光源，否则现在进去不安全。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Another fully dark place
Translation: 又一个完全黑暗的地方。

Translation: 我觉得这个箱子跟那台机器有关，看起来我可以把它抬起来搬走。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Damnit, its a strong picklock. We need to find another key
Translation: 该死，这把锁很难撬。我们需要找另一把钥匙。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Holy shit, i think something opened, lets head to the big door quick
Translation: 我靠，好像有东西开了，我们赶紧去那扇大门。

Title: NETMESSAGE:What the fuck, did we all just passed out and saw the same dream or something? might be
Translation: 卧槽，我们是不是都晕过去做了同一个梦？有可能。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Still something tells me than we didnt even visit the radar yet.
Translation: 不过还是有什么告诉我，我们连雷达都没去过。
